facts.summary: Interim survival gain only modest, program discontinued, 40% layoffs · Phase 1B · SL-172154 + azacitidine in TP53m AML/HR-MDS · not yet approved
facts.indication: TP53 mutant acute myeloid leukemia and higher-risk myelodysplastic syndromes

evidence.summary: showed only modest improvement in median overall survival compared to azacitidine monotherapy benchmarks; further development of SL-172154 discontinued
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: the promising complete remission rates we previously shared from our Phase 1 clinical trial did not translate to clinically meaningful improvements in median overall survival
evidence.safety: SL-172154 showed a manageable safety profile with Infusion-Related Reactions (IRRs) as the most common SL-172154 treatment-emergent adverse events
evidence.program_discontinued: today announced a strategic pipeline prioritization to include the discontinuation of its clinical program, SL-172154.
